comparison.objective: Release a hot air-fryer basket from its drawer and place it on a heat-proof mat.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a release button, lift by the handle, transport, and avoid hot surfaces.
comparison.success_condition: Basket released on the mat and still, button extended, hands clear, with no hot-surface contact.
comparison.reason: Button-actuated extraction and guarded transport do not test precision rail-to-jig mating, supported linear transfer, or rolling-element containment.
